task: Lisan prose to Maqayis root-entry retrieval; weak bibliographic correspondence, NOT sense equivalence
source_scope: pinned dictionary prose; not a fully vocalized free Arabic benchmark
label: unique normalized root entry shared across dictionaries
normalization: root-index hamza/alif/ya folding and doubled biliteral expansion; exact source bytes retained
split: SHA256(nabt-lexical-root-split-v1:root) first 8 hex modulo 10: test 0, dev 1, train others
leakage_controls: mask contiguous headword and spelled letter names
test labels not used for fitting or selection
residual_leakage: derived lexemes and shared dictionary wording can remain; test is entry retrieval, not independent semantic understanding
features: CRC32 word and character 3/4 grams, log TF and training IDF; bounded 384 features
selection: highest dev MRR over epochs and fixed baseline/neural fusion alphas; ties prefer lower alpha then earlier epoch
baseline: L2 normalized training-IDF weighted hashed lexical cosine
candidate_gallery: all retained Maqayis entries, including training roots
metrics: paired bootstrap 95% CI on top1 difference
acceptance: report first held-out test and all regressions; no quality or completeness claim from number of pairs
